summary_1line: Arjuna reveals his identities and explains his ten names to Uttara, then prepares for battle while assuring the prince of victory.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna standing beside the chariot recites his ten heroic names while the prince Uttara listens in awe beneath a spreading tree.
Uttara climbs down from a tree carrying Arjuna’s hidden weapons as the warrior prepares to arm himself.
Arjuna on the chariot with the Gandiva bow describes the car as a fortress while the anxious prince stands ready to drive.
